text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a pediatric patient with a three-week history of fatigue, fever, easy bruising, and severe leg pain. speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text: The leg pain waking you at night is a very specific detail; does it feel like deep bone pain rather than just muscle soreness? Also, have you noticed any swelling in your joints, or any recent infections or illnesses? REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count_with_Differential.

speaker: Measurement

text: The blood results confirm a significant decrease in platelets and an elevated white blood cell count, which explains the bruising and fever. Given the severe bone pain and these lab findings, could you tell me if you have noticed any bleeding gums, petechiae (small red dots on the skin), or if anyone in your family recently had a similar illness? REQUEST TEST: Peripheral_Blood_Smear.
